incarnation: The Aether Crown — currently selected individual Merek Flint V2 original-project portrait (2026)

references.provenance: Exact selected bytes restored by root from matching local Git LFS object; personally opened in current turn.

silhouette: Broad stocky human boiler-knight, oversized rounded shoulder plates, huge segmented steel boots and gauntlets; head uncovered.
anatomy: Two human arms and legs, five-finger armored hands; source stance holds hammer shaft in anatomical RIGHT hand, LEFT closed near side.
face: Short spiky dark brown hair swept upward, angular square face, warm light skin, dark eyebrows, short full dark beard; stern expression.
costume: Charcoal gunmetal full plate with thick riveted brass edges, round orange slotted furnace at chest, orange vents on anatomical LEFT shoulder and LEFT forearm; tall cylindrical smoking boiler behind anatomical RIGHT shoulder; belt pouches and long torn rust-orange apron/tabard; no helmet.
equipment: Large two-handed steam hammer: long charcoal shaft, brass pommel and brass collars, massive dark cylindrical head with thick brass end rings, glowing orange vertical slots and curved brass lower pipe. Source holds shaft in anatomical RIGHT hand.
palette: Gunmetal charcoal, warm weathered brass, ember-orange furnace/vents/tabard; dark brown hair and beard.
distinguishingMarks: Orange circular barred chest core, large asymmetrical smoking right-shoulder boiler; left-shoulder and forearm orange vents.
forbiddenMixes: No slim young civil in blue longcoat from historical atlas; no sword/pistol, clean white tunic, helmet, shaved face, mirror-swapped boiler or orange vents.

scopeLimitations: Current selected V2 portrait is internal original-project identity authority, not external franchise evidence.
